name: THMY Holdings Berhad
summary: THMY Holdings Berhad, through its subsidiaries, involved in the provision of automated test solutions for electrical and electronics products. The company's automated test solutions comprise in-circuit test solutions to test for assembly defects, such as component placement errors, component faults, soldering defects, short circuits, and electrical interruptions; and functional circuit test solutions to test whether the printed circuit board assembly are functioning according to its intended logic and functionality.
